facts.text: The College of Saint Benedict and Saint John's University share one common curriculum, where students take co-ed classes on both campuses and fulfill identical graduation requirements.

sources.title: Our Unique Partnership | CSB+SJU - College of Saint Benedict
sources.quote: Students take classes on both campuses. In fact, CSB and SJU share one common curriculum. Classes are co-ed and graduation requirements are the same for both schools.
